SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-30-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFFS LUIS VILLAFRANCA AND JACQUELINE BILLERA ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT MARIO MORALES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ADDRESS THE ISSUE OF IMPROPER VENUE WITH THE COURT AND STATES THAT THIS SHOULD BE IN SAN MATEO COUNTY. COURT FINDS THAT THIS SHOULD BE IN SAN MATEO COUNTY. COURT PROVIDES DEFENDANT THE CHOICE OF DISMISSING THE CASE DUE TO IMPROPER VENUE, OR IF DEFENDANT WAIVES VENUE, THE COURT MAY GO FORWARD WITH TRIAL. DEFENDANT WAIVES VENUE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VILLAFRANCA, LUIS BILLERA, JACQUELINE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MORALES, MARIO $1,925.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,975.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
